import numpy as np
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view

D = np.load('/work/region_data.npz')
base = D['base']; tgt = D['tgt']
t_base = D['t_base']; t_tgt = D['t_tgt']
Tb = len(t_base)

# fixed (month,day) -> day-of-year mapping: Jan1=1, Feb28=59, Feb29=60, Mar1=61 ... Dec31=366
mdays = np.array([31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31])
cum = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(mdays)])
def doy_of(strs):
    m = np.array([int(s[5:7]) for s in strs]); d = np.array([int(s[8:10]) for s in strs])
    doy = cum[m-1] + d
    doy[(m == 2) & (d == 29)] = 60
    return doy
doyb = doy_of(t_base)
doyt = doy_of(t_tgt)
print("target doys:", doyt.min(), doyt.max(), "unique count", len(set(doyt.tolist())), "has 60?", 60 in set(doyt.tolist()))

in_base = (t_base >= "1992-01-01") & (t_base <= "2002-12-31")
print("baseline anchor days:", in_base.sum(), t_base[in_base][0], t_base[in_base][-1])

thr = np.full((366, 3600), np.nan); clim = np.full((366, 3600), np.nan)
sizes = set()
for dd in range(1, 367):
    if dd == 60:
        continue
    idx = np.where((doyb == dd) & in_base)[0]
    pool = np.concatenate([base[i-5:i+6] for i in idx])
    sizes.add(pool.shape[0])
    vals = pool.reshape(pool.shape[0], 3600)
    thr[dd-1] = np.nanquantile(vals, 0.90, axis=0, method='hazen')
    clim[dd-1] = np.nanmean(vals, axis=0)
print("pool sizes per doy:", sizes)

# fill day 60 (index 59) with mean of 59 and 61 (indices 58, 60)
thr[59] = (thr[58] + thr[60]) / 2.0
clim[59] = (clim[58] + clim[60]) / 2.0

# 31-day centred wrap-around moving mean over the 366-element arrays
def smooth366(a):
    pad = np.concatenate([a[-15:], a, a[:15]])
    return sliding_window_view(pad, 31).mean(axis=1)
thr_s = smooth366(thr); clim_s = smooth366(clim)

# sea cells: finite on every target day
sea = np.isfinite(tgt).all(axis=0)
print("sea cells:", sea.sum(), "of", 3600)
ns = int(sea.sum())
print("thr_s finite for sea cells all doys:", bool(np.isfinite(thr_s[:, sea]).all()))

# sanity: thresholds for target doys in deg C
sub = thr_s[doyt-1][:, sea]
print("smoothed thr during Jun-Aug (degC): min %.3f med %.3f max %.3f" % (
    (sub.min()-273.15), np.median(sub-273.15), (sub.max()-273.15)))
print("tgt SST (degC): min %.3f med %.3f max %.3f" % (
    np.nanmin(tgt[:,sea]-273.15), np.nanmedian(tgt[:,sea]-273.15), np.nanmax(tgt[:,sea]-273.15)))

np.savez_compressed('/work/intermediate.npz',
    thr_s=thr_s, clim_s=clim_s, sea=sea, doyt=doyt,
    t_tgt=t_tgt, lat=D['lat'], lon=D['lon'])
print("intermediates saved")

import numpy as np
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

D = np.load('/work/region_data.npz')
base = D['base']; tgt = D['tgt']
t_base = D['t_base']; t_tgt = D['t_tgt']

cum = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum([31,29,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31])])
def doy_of(strs):
    m = np.array([int(s[5:7]) for s in strs]); d = np.array([int(s[8:10]) for s in strs])
    return cum[m-1] + d
doyb = doy_of(t_base); doyt = doy_of(t_tgt)
in_base = (t_base >= "1992-01-01") & (t_base <= "2002-12-31")

thr = np.full((366, 3600), np.nan); clim = np.full((366, 3600), np.nan)
for dd in range(1, 367):
    if dd == 60:
        continue
    idx = np.where((doyb == dd) & in_base)[0]
    pool = np.concatenate([base[i-5:i+6] for i in idx]).reshape(121, 3600)
    thr[dd-1] = np.nanquantile(pool, 0.90, axis=0, method='hazen')
    clim[dd-1] = np.nanmean(pool, axis=0)
thr[59] = (thr[58] + thr[60]) / 2.0
clim[59] = (clim[58] + clim[60]) / 2.0

def smooth366(a):
    pad = np.concatenate([a[-15:], a, a[:15]])
    return sliding_window_view(pad, 31, axis=0).mean(axis=-1)
thr_s = smooth366(thr); clim_s = smooth366(clim)

sea = np.isfinite(tgt).all(axis=0).ravel()   # (3600,)
ns = int(sea.sum())
print("sea cells:", ns, "of 3600")
print("non-finite thr_s (sea x days):", int((~np.isfinite(thr_s[:, sea])).sum()),
      "| clim_s:", int((~np.isfinite(clim_s[:, sea])).sum()),
      "| raw thr:", int((~np.isfinite(thr[:, sea])).sum()))

# ---- per-cell MHW over target period ----
T = tgt[:, sea]                      # (92, ns) float64
tht = thr_s[doyt-1][:, sea]          # (92, ns)
hot = T >= tht                       # (92, ns)
print("hot fraction (Jun-Aug):", float(hot.mean()))

mhw = np.zeros((92, ns), bool)
n_cells_with_mhw = 0
for c in range(ns):
    x = hot[:, c].astype(np.int8)
    p = np.concatenate([[0], x, [0]])
    diff = np.diff(p)
    starts = np.where(diff == 1)[0]
    ends   = np.where(diff == -1)[0]   # exclusive
    ev = [[s, e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends) if (e - s) >= 5]
    if not ev:
        continue
    merged = [ev[0]]
    for s, e in ev[1:]:
        if s - merged[-1][1] <= 2:
            merged[-1][1] = e
        else:
            merged.append([s, e])
    for s, e in merged:
        mhw[s:e, c] = True
    n_cells_with_mhw += 1
print("cells with >=1 per-cell MHW:", n_cells_with_mhw)

active = mhw.any(axis=1)
# regional events: maximal runs of active days
p = np.concatenate([[0], active.astype(np.int8), [0]])
diff = np.diff(p)
st = t_tgt[np.where(diff == 1)[0]]
en = t_tgt[np.where(diff == -1)[0] - 1]
events = [(str(a), str(b)) for a, b in zip(st, en)]
print("regional events:")
for e in events:
    print("  ", e)
print("total active days:", int(active.sum()))

np.savez_compressed('/work/final_state.npz',
    mhw=mhw, sea=sea, doyt=doyt, t_tgt=t_tgt, lat=D['lat'], lon=D['lon'],
    events_onset=np.array([e[0] for e in events]), events_end=np.array([e[1] for e in events]))
print("saved final state")

import numpy as np

def mhw_mask_of(hot, minlen=5, gap=2):
    n = len(hot)
    p = np.concatenate([[0], hot.astype(np.int8), [0]])
    df = np.diff(p)
    s = np.where(df == 1)[0]; e = np.where(df == -1)[0]
    ev = [[a, b] for a, b in zip(s, e) if (b - a) >= minlen]
    if not ev:
        return np.zeros(n, bool)
    merged = [ev[0]]
    for a, b in ev[1:]:
        if a - merged[-1][1] <= gap:
            merged[-1][1] = b
        else:
            merged.append([a, b])
    out = np.zeros(n, bool)
    for a, b in merged:
        out[a:b] = True
    return out

def runs(mask):
    p = np.concatenate([[0], mask.astype(np.int8), [0]]); df = np.diff(p)
    return list(zip(np.where(df==1)[0], np.where(df==-1)[0]))

# case 1: exactly 5 hot days -> event
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[10:15] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(10, 15)], runs(mhw_mask_of(h))
# case 2: 4 hot days -> none
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[10:14] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == []
# case 3: two 5-runs, gap 2 -> merged incl. gap days
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[5:10] = True; h[12:17] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(5, 17)], runs(mhw_mask_of(h))
# case 4: two 5-runs, gap 3 -> two events
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[5:10] = True; h[13:18] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(5, 10), (13, 18)]
# case 5: transitive merge A(5) gap1 B(3) gap1 C(5) -> one event
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[0:5] = True; h[6:9] = True; h[10:15] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 15)], runs(mhw_mask_of(h))
# case 6: runs at both boundaries
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[0:5] = True; h[87:92] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 5), (87, 92)]
# case 7: single hot day -> none; all hot -> one
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[40] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == []
h = np.ones(92, bool)
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 92)]
# case 8: 6-run with internal single cold day: A(3) gap1 B(3) -> merged 7
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[20:23] = True; h[24:27] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(20, 27)]
# case 9: A(3) gap1 B(2): neither >=5 alone; gap<=2 but neither qualifies -> none
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[20:23] = True; h[24:26] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [], runs(mhw_mask_of(h))
print("all MHW run/merge unit tests passed")

import numpy as np

def mhw_mask_of(hot, minlen=5, gap=2):
    n = len(hot)
    p = np.concatenate([[0], hot.astype(np.int8), [0]])
    df = np.diff(p)
    s = np.where(df == 1)[0]; e = np.where(df == -1)[0]
    ev = [[a, b] for a, b in zip(s, e) if (b - a) >= minlen]
    if not ev:
        return np.zeros(n, bool)
    merged = [ev[0]]
    for a, b in ev[1:]:
        if a - merged[-1][1] <= gap:
            merged[-1][1] = b
        else:
            merged.append([a, b])
    out = np.zeros(n, bool)
    for a, b in merged:
        out[a:b] = True
    return out

def runs(mask):
    p = np.concatenate([[0], mask.astype(np.int8), [0]]); df = np.diff(p)
    return list(zip(np.where(df==1)[0], np.where(df==-1)[0]))

h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[10:15] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(10, 15)]
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[10:14] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == []
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[5:10] = True; h[12:17] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(5, 17)]          # gap 2 -> merged incl. gap days
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[5:10] = True; h[13:18] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(5, 10), (13, 18)]  # gap 3 -> separate
# transitive: A(5) gap1 B(5) gap1 C(5) -> single event (0,15)
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[0:5] = True; h[6:11] = True; h[12:17] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 17)], runs(mhw_mask_of(h))
# non-MHW 3-day gap between two MHWs: no bridge (gap of 5 days)
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[0:5] = True; h[6:9] = True; h[10:15] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 5), (10, 15)], runs(mhw_mask_of(h))
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[0:5] = True; h[87:92] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 5), (87, 92)]
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[40] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == []
h = np.ones(92, bool)
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == [(0, 92)]
# A(3) gap1 B(3): no run >=5 anywhere -> none
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[20:23] = True; h[24:27] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == []
# A(3) gap1 B(2) -> none
h = np.zeros(92, bool); h[20:23] = True; h[24:26] = True
assert runs(mhw_mask_of(h)) == []
print("all MHW run/merge unit tests passed")
